## Executive summary {.part}

Training 50,000 engineers by 2030 is the binding constraint on the programme.

Refining capacity, not extraction, is the real bottleneck.

## Context {.part}

Demand grows with electrification while refining remains concentrated.

Policy attention should follow the midstream rather than the mine.
